metadata.description: Common developer toolkit — reusable, project-agnostic Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: test-utils
plugins.description: E2E and browser-debugging utilities (enabled by default): gen-e2e-test authors self-contained Playwright tests with API reports, gen-e2e-record turns codegen recordings into tests, and dev-browser provides agent-side UI debugging.

plugins.name: analysis-estimation
plugins.description: Analysis & estimation suite (enabled by default): rfp-requirement-analysis → rfp-architecture-design → rfp-sa-bdd forms a traceable RFP/SOW pipeline; cold-estimation delivers method-based initial estimates with risk effort for new and existing systems; quality-orchestrator runs a writer→reviewer→fixer checklist loop.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Everyday dev toolkit: token-usage diagnosis, prompt tuning, goal setting, delegation, long-running strategic execution, wayfinder decision maps, and plain-language or visual explainers.

plugins.name: common-lab
plugins.description: Common Lab (experimental): 22 lab skills — delegate; a Jev request router (suggest-jev), TypeSafe Jev setup (init-jev), yes/no gate (jev-gate), list pick (jev-pick), rubric score (jev-score), Jev opportunity finder (jever), jev-browser (dev-browser with Jev element picking), a stop check (none-stop-jever), an ask-the-user check (is-truely-need-to-ask-user-jev), and Jev overlays that add Jev readings to define-goal, strategic-advance, delegate, contract, seal, review, think, ui, show-me, wait-what, wayfinder, and cold-estimation (*-jever) — plus 1 bundled agent (executor). Graduated skills now live in the stable plugins: grilling, domain-modeling, research, prototype, wait-what, wayfinder, show-me in common; think, contract, seal, review in baransu 5.5.0. The Lab estimate, define-goal and better-prompts variants were retired in 0.9.0 and the Lab strategic-advance variant in 0.10.0; use analysis-estimation:cold-estimation, common:define-goal, common:better-prompts and common:strategic-advance. Invoke as /common-lab:<skill>. Enabled by default once installed; disable with `claude plugin disable common-lab` if unwanted.

plugins.name: linkstart
plugins.description: LinkStart v1 Preview integration (enabled by default): one link-start workflow reconnects an interactive HTML or localhost app to the same Claude Code session or Codex thread through the exact bundled Runtime, private session context, and one-call arm/respond monitor flow.

plugins.name: common-mod
plugins.description: Claude Code mods (Claude only; enabled by default): recall — type @@ to pull a past Claude Code, desktop or Cowork conversation into the prompt, /recall for a per-project activity strata and preview; side — /side opens a throwaway side chat beside the transcript, answered from the main conversation without touching it, plus 看不懂 (re-explain a reply, wait-what style) and 畫給我看 (a plain-text diagram of a reply, a quick show-me) on hovering a reply or via /side ? and /side 畫.
